name: Coupon Attached
definition: Physical certificates representing rights attached to the physical certificates representing a security.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date of the coupon attached to the physical security.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Number of the coupon attached to the physical security.

CouponClippingDate.name: Coupon Clipping Date
CouponClippingDate.definition: Date on which the coupons are to be/were submitted for payment of interest.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Instrument to which a coupon is specified.
